business.body: Kiran Syntex Limited (CIN L13999GJ1986PLC009099) is a public limited company engaged in the business of manufacturing and trading of yarn and textile products, with its registered office at 1/324, Popat Mohalla, Nanpura, Surat - 395001, Gujarat, India. The Board's Report states the Company is 'mainly engaged in the business of trading of yarn and textile products', and the segment note confirms it operated in a single business segment during the year, namely trading activities, with the CODM reviewing performance on an overall basis. At an Extraordinary General Meeting held on 22/12/2025 the Company altered its main business object by adding various additional business activities.
